excerpt: The existence of non-zero neutrino masses points to the likely existence of multiple SM neutral fermions. When such states are heavy enough that they cannot be produced in oscillations, they are referred to as Heavy Neutral Leptons (HNLs).
publisher: arXiv (preprint); A. M. Abdullahi, P. Barham Alzas, B. Batell, A. Boyarsky et al. (45 authors)
title: The Present and Future Status of Heavy Neutral Leptons
